scope: MB-004 / R1-008 / BC-008, local HTTP integration with synthetic inputs
author: DSH24 harness and content guard, Grok52 direct TLS restriction and runtime bounds, Grok55 JWKS observation, Root execution

results.database: MySQL 8.0 disposable iam_service, Flyway V19 and synthetic three-document control-plane rows

earlier_runs.cause: Reproducible jar mtime 1980 was incorrectly used as a freshness gate. Services did not start. Confirmed content and exact jar hashes.

Read path reached 99/101, including exact three texts and hashes. Stopped at browser-Origin 403 on public JWKS when test reused the browser helper. Server-to-server lookup and browser-Origin diagnostic were separated.

limits: Gateway password registration or login; no prior runtime is treated as evidence
formal legal publication, authorizer approval, deployed Gateway/IAM, production rollout
actual mobile H5/browser or native app, device secure storage, screen reader, real device
browser-enforced CORS, cookie partitioning, and certificate UX (only HTTP-level preflight/cookie attributes are checked)
withdrawal, logout, refresh-token replay detection, multi-device kickout
invalid body digest, missing body, oversize body, NUL body or partial projection over HTTP (unit/JDBC tests exist, not repeated here)
durable audit-service ingest and database-level audit row assertions
visual onboarding UI, navigation, i18n and responsive behavior
